name: strategy_playbook
description: Reference sheet for NEEZY's named strategies: what each rule looks for, its typical regime, and how consensus weights it. Educational reference for the chat assistant and the scan tools.

strategies.name: SUPERTREND
strategies.signal: Direction of the ATR(14) x3 trailing line; flip events reset the bias.

strategies.name: EMA_PULLBACK
strategies.signal: In an EMA50 uptrend, buy tags of the EMA21 that close back above it (mirror for downtrends).
strategies.weak_regime: Deep, fast reversals invalidates the tag.

strategies.name: DIVERGENCE
strategies.signal: Fractal-pivot RSI/MACD-histogram divergence against the price extreme, scored 0-1 by strength.
strategies.weak_regime: Strong trends print serial divergences that keep running.

strategies.name: DONCHIAN
strategies.signal: Close beyond the 20-bar high/low channel with follow-through.

strategies.name: SQUEEZE
strategies.signal: Bollinger bandwidth in its lowest percentile while price coils inside the Keltner channel.
strategies.weak_regime: Squeezes can resolve slowly or in both directions.

strategies.name: MACD
strategies.signal: Histogram sign with slope agreement against EMA50 context.
strategies.weak_regime: Ranging markets flip the histogram repeatedly.

strategies.name: KELTNER
strategies.signal: Close outside the EMA20/ATR1.5 channel with rising ATR.

strategies.name: CORRELATION_DIVERGENCE
strategies.signal: Short-window rolling correlation versus a long baseline: converging, decoupling, stable, or inverted.
strategies.best_regime: Basket context where one leg leads.
strategies.weak_regime: Correlation regime shifts with no lead-lag.

consensus.rule: run_all() scores every strategy; consensus() builds a vote-weighted verdict from direction x confidence.
consensus.interpretation: Wide agreement across kinds (trend + momentum + volatility) is treated as a stronger context than any single vote.
consensus.caveat: Votes are correlations observed on past candles, not forecasts.
